text: Or, strike thee with sixe plagues, Or, drawe thee backe, with an book of six teeth, as chap. 38. 4. , Heb. the sides of the North.
Hebr. the face of the field.
Or, iauelins. , Or, make a fire of them.
Or, mouthes. , That is, the multitude of Gog.
Heb. to the foule of euery wing. , Or, slaughter.
Hebr. by my causing of them &c.
